data.title: PitchBook-NVCA Venture Monitor, Q4 2021
data.summary: US venture-backed companies raised $329.6 billion in 2021, against a previous record of $166.6 billion in 2020. The report states the figures verbatim; they are data-provider estimates and are revised in later vintages.
data.citation: PitchBook Data and National Venture Capital Association, Q4 2021 PitchBook-NVCA Venture Monitor, 13 January 2022.
